title: Void Beast
description: A mod filled with whatever I felt like adding at the moment! With a focus on exploration and collection, I'm sure there's something in the mod for you. If not, yeah that's fair.
body:
**This mod is still a major work in progress. Not only are some things unfinished, you may find some things to be janky or buggy. If you find issues or bugs, please join my Discord and let me know.**

![ALT: Minecraft: Void Beast](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8a5ce68458b0b6d479590b90e36fb75fafc7d51d.png)

**IT IS RECOMMENDED THAT YOU PLAY WITH JEI, NATURES COMPASS, AND EXPLORER'S COMPASS**

Want to know where to start? Craft a Bat and start exploring! I recommend playing with extra mods like Natures Compass and JEI. The mod is heavily referencial, many things in the mod are references to things I enjoy, but I still try to introduce these features in unique and fun ways. If you have a suggestion to improve any features then I'd love to hear them!


**Permissions:**

_Modpacks:_ You may use this mod in modpacks and edit any features to fit your packs balance. Should you use it in a pack and upload it to a site that doesn't show the mod authors, I would appreciate credit in some way.

_Reuploads:_ You may NOT upload this mod to Curseforge unless it is in a modpack. I purposefully left out Curseforge for a reason. If there are other sites that you think the mod should be on, ask me and I will upload them there.

_Addons:_ You may make addons to the mod, feel free. 

**Extra:**

This is my first mod, and I never thought I'd be able to make something like this. It's not perfect, hell it might not even be good. But I hope you enjoy it. If you'd like to contribute to the mod in some way I have channels in my Discord dedicated to just that.
